title: the quarry_index machine's code is deleted
intention: cairn/machines/quarry_index/ is deleted whole; nothing in class-space names it; its output CairnCommons/quarry/ stays in the commons.
why: Outline 17.13 (Q#44, Akien 2026-11-06, CairnCommons 210bfe67^): 'one-time compiler over TheIgorsProject's ideas; ran once, done. Its code is deleted (1.2.7); its output, CairnCommons/quarry/, is knowledge and stays in the commons.' Rule 1.3.7 now: code no longer needed is deleted; git history keeps it. Measured 2026-11-08: zero callers outside its folder.
traces_to: Law 5 (the repo is itself the state of the machine); outline 1.3.7.
how: git rm -r cairn/machines/quarry_index; recompile the intentions lab; a red-first retirement proof in bin/proofs that later retirement tickets extend with their own PROVES keys.

clauses.claim: cairn/machines/quarry_index/ is absent from the working tree
no file in the repo outside .git and this proof names cairn.machines.quarry_index or cairn/machines/quarry_index
python3 -m cairn.machines.quarry_index.compiler exits nonzero with 'No module named'

decisions.text: D1: red-first proof bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py, check()/FAILURES/main() shape like bin/proofs/test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus.py, PASS/FAIL labels naming the PROVES teeth, PROVES = {'80df7712b8c5': {'1': ..., '2': ..., '3': ...}}. It reads only the repo (never CairnCommons: the hollow worktree has none beside it). Later retirement tickets add their own PROVES key and teeth to this same file.

D2: git rm -r cairn/machines/quarry_index (compiler.py, __init__.py, intention+why.json, proofs/, validations/), then run cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh so the lab copy goes. CairnCommons/quarry/ is not touched.

D3: run the proof red before D2, green twice after, commit, seal with bin/cairn test --seal bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py. The verdict also checks by instrument that the lab copy is gone and CairnCommons/quarry/ is unchanged (git status).

D4: tooth 3 imports the module (python -c 'import ...compiler') instead of running -m, so the red-first run could not execute the compiler and rewrite the index; tooth 2 skips dot-files and dot-folders (.git, .pytest_cache, .artifact-journal.jsonl) because those are records and caches that name what passed through, not callers

FIXME 1: the nothing-names search skips each component's records of truth by name: history.json, state.json and every file under a validations/ folder. They are append-only journals of what passed through, never callers, the same reason the dot-records are skipped (D4); the tooth's docstring says so.

measured.saw: no caller of quarry_index outside its own folder
